info.name: Sanad App — Elderly
info.description: Elderly self-service app routes. Requests require an Elderly Normal JWT. The take-dose request writes shared medication history and is a manual fixture example; use only an approved disposable fixture and do not replay it after a successful take.

request.description: Normal Elderly JWT. The dependent is resolved from the authenticated Elderly identity; no dependent ID is accepted. Read-only.

item.name: Get medication dashboard for profile-local date

request.description: Read-only. date is required as YYYY-MM-DD and uses the linked Elderly profile's local calendar semantics; it has no server-date default.
Contract check; with a valid Elderly JWT this should return 400 because date is required.

item.name: Record scheduled dose as taken — manual fixture only

request.description: STATE-CHANGING: records a shared dose log, attributes the action to the Elderly user, and decrements tracked stock. Only use an approved disposable fixture where this medication is Active, the date is in range, and scheduledTime is configured. A second or racing take must be rejected. Do not replay against shared or production data.
